t: How the Cross-Domain Discovery Engine works (Signature)
title: How the Cross-Domain Discovery Engine works (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Cross-Domain Discovery Engine does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature approach builds a role-labeled graph per domain and matches relational structure deterministically — the same two domains always yield the same candidate analogies. Each proposal carries its structure-mapping ledger: which roles aligned, the fidelity score, and the transfer hypothesis stated as a testable claim. Surface-similar but structurally hollow candidates are rejected by a fixed fidelity floor. This is a Signature-authored method, original to Justin Addam Higgins.
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.
